Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Colorado Springs hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Colorado Springs hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: trivago DEALS at 5, KAYAK.com at 3, Vio.com at 3, the hotel's own site at 2, Super.com at 1 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Colorado Springs rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 16 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line. Taxes and fees at Colorado Springs hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Spark by Hilton Colorado Springs I 25 Central to 14% at Cheyenne Mountain Resort, a Destination by Hyatt Hotel. At 8 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
